text_block_list.text:
While walking with Эйр Грув in the
central
plaza, I hear a loud voice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Talk to ya later, mom! Love ya lots!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Oh! Howdy, Эйр Грув!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
I should have guessed it was you. Was
that your
mother on the line?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You betcha! Just puttin' in a request for
some
snacks!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
There's this snack that they don't sell
here!
Barbecue-flavored carrot chips!
Yum!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
S-seriously? Don't you think it's a bit

presumptuous to expect that of her?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Nah, she's pleased as punch to do it! She
gets the
biggest smile whenever I ask for
anythin'.
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Are you sayin' your mom doesn't spoil you, Air Groove?
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
My mother is very busy. She doesn't
have time to
waste on such things.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What in tarnation?! Moms gotta spoil their kids! It's in the constitution!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
You're sayin' she doesn't get on your
case about
how much you call? Or send
care packages you
didn't even ask for?
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Ngh... Well, sometimes...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Sheesh! I bet she's just waitin'
for ya to
ask her for some love!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Hurry up and give her a call, why don't
ya!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Why do your wild claims sound so
oddly
persuasive?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
But I've never done anything like that
before. I
wouldn't know what to say...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Just say you want to hear her voice.
Isn't there anything you'd like her to send?

text_block_list.text:
But I've never done anything like that
before. I
wouldn't know what to say...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: Just say you want to hear her voice.
Isn't there anything you'd like her to send?

text_block_list.text: I... guess I could do that...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
There ya go! Sounds like a fine idea to
me! I know
I give my mom a ring just to
hear her voice
sometimes.
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: ...All right. I'll go call her.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
What're we doin' just standin' around
for? We're
gettin' after her, ain't we?
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Well, I... I was wondering how you were.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Is everything all right?! What
happened?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text:
No, nothing. I'm fine. I just... wanted to
hear your
voice.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Something has happened, hasn't it? This is so unlike you...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text:
N-no, I said I'm fine! I really just wanted
to talk
with you!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
One of the other students said that
mothers get
worried if their daughters
don't ask for their help
from time to
time...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. Oh, Эйр Грув, I take it back—this is exactly like you.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text: I appreciate the gesture, dear. You do whatever it is you want to do though, okay?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I promise to keep doing my
best over
here.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув! Aren't you just as cute as a
button?!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Wh-where did you come from?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I swear, if you ain't just the sweetest
little bundle
of cute when you're talkin'
with your mom!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Aha! I see what's going on!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You two are about to receive a lesson in
what
happens when you eavesdrop on
people! And you
can believe that's a
mistake you won't be making
again!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Come on, I'm not a child.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Like snacks!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Don't lump me in with you! Snacks!
Good grief...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hold on... I've thought of
something. I'll go
call her.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: All right, let's get after her!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
Hello, Mother. Do you remember those
cookies
you used to make when I was
younger?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I've been trying to recreate them from
memory,
but it's not going so well.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Want me to send you the recipe?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text:
Actually, I was... wondering if you might
be willing
to... Instead of the recipe...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: This ain't going so hot! Wait here a tick!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text:
No, no, no, darling! If you want some of
mom's
cookies, you can't beat around
the bush!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Taiki?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Oh, I see! Эйр Грув, you
were always
so indirect!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Is that Taiki there with you? Hi! Take
good care
of Эйр Грув, please!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text: You got it, boss!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: Mother, please...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I'll bake a batch of cookies and send
them as
soon as I can! I'll be sure to send
enough for your
friends, so give some to
Taiki too!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув's Mother

text_block_list.text: ...So. Do you two have anything to say for yourselves?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув
choice_data_list: I'm happy she got the message!

text_block_list.text: Yup! Everyone's happy!
text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл

text_block_list.text: You fools! That is not what I'm referring to!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: And so, Эйр Грув gives us an earful...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув gives us quite the earful, but
it does
seem somewhat shorter than her
usual lectures.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I find some cookies on
my desk.
They have a refined flavor and
a certain warmth
that lingers on the
tongue. Absolutely delicious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
